scenes.title: Gate
scenes.description: A photograph from the National Library of Norway, dated 1954 and in the public domain, showing a gate. No photographer, location, or further details are stated in the record.
scenes.explanation: Coin-operated parking meters were not installed in Oslo until well after 1954, so one standing on this street is impossible for the year.
scenes.credit: Henriksen & Steen via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: [NF.WB 45850* B Fabrikk]
scenes.description: A photograph from 1940, held by the National Library of Norway under the catalogue number NF.WB 45850* B Fabrikk, showing a factory. It is in the public domain, and the record does not state a photographer.
scenes.anomaly: modern plastic squeeze bottle of bookbinding glue
scenes.explanation: A molded plastic squeeze bottle with a nozzle cap did not exist in 1940, when glue was sold in glass jars, tins or pots.
scenes.credit: Wilse, Anders Beer, Norsk folkemuseum via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: Hill climb at Montanglaust, first in the first motorcycle category
scenes.description: A press photograph by Agence Rol showing the first-place finisher in the first category of motorcycles at the Montanglaust hill climb at Nervy sur Levis, dated 25 February 1912. It belongs to the Bibliothèque nationale de France, département Estampes et photographie, and is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: Plastic zip ties were not invented until 1958, so this fastening cannot exist on a 1912 motorcycle.

scenes.title: Kindergarten Outing by Tram
scenes.description: A photograph from 1947 in the collection of the National Library of Norway shows a barnehage på tur med sporvogn, that is, a kindergarten on an outing by tram. It is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: Inline skates with a single row of wheels did not exist in 1947; they only became common in the 1980s.
scenes.credit: Mittet & Co. AS via National Library of Norway

scenes.title: [Denofa, fabrikk i Fredrikstad]
scenes.description: A photograph from 1900 shows the Denofa factory in Fredrikstad. It is held by the National Library of Norway and is in the public domain.
scenes.explanation: Intermodal steel shipping containers were not introduced until the 1950s, so none could exist on this 1900 quay.
scenes.credit: Skarpmoen, Narve via National Library of Norway
